failedCondition: Fresh accepted HUD Stop message absent
classifierLimitation: Unity JsonUtility omitted the nested per-actor list from every frame. Aggregate counts and failed bits are preserved, but exact actor identities cannot be independently requalified from this diagnostic.
likelySharedCause: SelectionHudFeedbackElement.Message is FixedString64Bytes; the Persian Stop message is 120 UTF-8 bytes and the ToFixed64 helper ignores Append overflow, leaving an accepted result with an empty message.
